import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    b = int(data[1])
    array = list(map(int, data[2:2+n]))

    cost = [-1] * n
    co = 0
    ce = 0

    for i in range(n):
        if array[i] % 2 == 0:
            ce += 1
        else:
            co += 1
        if co == ce and i != n - 1:
            cost[i] = abs(array[i+1] - array[i])
            co = 0
            ce = 0

    cost.sort()
    cut = 0
    sum_cost = 0
    for c in cost:
        if c != -1:
            sum_cost += c
            if sum_cost > b:
                break
            cut += 1

    print(cut)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
